description: This file defines a schema for Feishu wiki operations using the @sinclair/typebox library. It specifies various data structures for actions like 'spaces', 'nodes', 'get', 'search', 'create', 'move', and 'rename', including their associated parameters and types.

methods.name: Type.Union
methods.description: Creates a union of multiple types, allowing a value to match any of the provided schemas.

methods.name: Type.Object
methods.description: Defines an object schema with specified properties.

methods.name: Type.Literal
methods.description: Defines a schema with a specific literal value.

methods.name: Type.String
methods.description: Defines a string type, optionally with a description.

methods.name: Type.Optional
methods.description: Marks a schema property as optional.
